values.body:
Every page and post in the admin has a **Preview** button beside Save draft. It opens the entry’s saved draft on the site, in a tab of its own.

## How it works

1. The CMS works out the draft’s address on the site, from `previews` in `cms/sorlo.config.ts`, with a secret the site knows.
2. The site’s `/api/preview` checks the secret and turns on Next’s draft mode.
3. While draft mode is on, the site reads drafts with a preview key, and a bar at the top says so. **Exit preview** turns it off.

Preview shows what’s saved, so save your draft first.
values.title: Previewing a draft
values.author: 01a1ca0a-d29c-7959-bb3e-e176b662c424
values.excerpt: The Preview button opens your saved draft on the site, before anyone else sees it.
